lines.zh: 我沿着走廊走，袍子扫着地。
lines.en: I walk the corridor and my robe sweeps the floor.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边理我的胡子。
lines.en: I comb my beard as I walk.
I walk from the study to the window.

lines.zh: 我的帽尖在地上投下影子。
lines.en: My hat's point throws a shadow on the floor.

lines.zh: 我把袖子拢起来，慢慢踱。
lines.en: I gather my sleeves and pace slowly.
I count the tiles toward the door.

lines.zh: 我走过书架，手指划过书脊。
lines.en: I pass the shelf and my finger rides the spines.

lines.zh: 我停在楼梯下面，往上看了看。
lines.en: I stop at the stairs and look up.
I head for the yard for some air.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可脑子很快。
lines.en: My steps are slow. My mind is not.

lines.zh: 我把长袍的下摆提了一点。
lines.en: I lift the hem of my robe a little.
I pass through the archway.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边算着数字。
lines.en: I count figures as I walk.
I make three rounds of the room.
I sit and stare at a page.

lines.zh: 桌上摊着几张写满的纸。
lines.en: Several written sheets lie open on the desk.

lines.zh: 我把一片药草夹进书里。
lines.en: I press a herb between two pages.

lines.zh: 窗外的光正照到墨水瓶。
lines.en: The window light falls on the inkwell.

lines.zh: 我在想一个算不出来的数。
lines.en: I am chasing a figure that will not come.
I raise a hand and let it drop.

lines.zh: 楼下有脚步声，不是我的。
lines.en: Footsteps below. Not mine.
I trim the candle.
The top shelf is beyond my reach.

lines.zh: 这间屋子是我一间间住出来的。
lines.en: I have lived this house room by room.
I blow on the ink.

lines.zh: 窗外的树影子移到墙上。
lines.en: The tree shadow crosses the wall.

lines.zh: 我把手指在书页上停住。
lines.en: I stop my finger on the page.

lines.zh: 屋里有一股旧纸的味道。
lines.en: The room smells of old paper.
You stand in the doorway without entering.
I sell nothing here.

lines.zh: 你要问的事，我未必知道。
lines.en: I may not know what you came to ask.

lines.zh: 你的靴子带进来不少土。
lines.en: Your boots brought in a deal of soil.

lines.zh: 我认得这个门环的声音。
lines.en: I know the sound of that door knocker.
Sit down. Do not touch my books.
A wizard's robe needs the light.
I take no apprentices.
My memory is not what it was.

lines.zh: 你说慢一点，我年纪大了。
lines.en: Speak slowly. I am old.
Come into the light.

lines.zh: 我这儿只有书，没有别的。
lines.en: There are only books here.
You should take that hat off.
I speak slowly. Do not hurry me.
Do not touch anything in this room.
You smell of the road.
That made me stoop.
My brim is askew and the spell scattered.
I hold the desk to stay upright.
My robe is torn.
I cough twice and smooth my robe.
At my age wounds close slowly.
Blood dripped on my papers.

lines.zh: 这一下，写进我的册子里
lines.en: This goes into my ledger.

lines.zh: 我挪到书架后头，躲一躲
lines.en: I move behind the bookshelf and hide.
I lean on the desk and hold on a while.
Is that a book?
That interests me somewhat.

lines.zh: 这点东西抵不上一页纸。
lines.en: That is not worth one page.

lines.zh: 我拿过来看了看，放下了。
lines.en: I take it up, look, and set it down.

lines.zh: 这味道像我年轻时闻过的。
lines.en: I smelled this when I was young.

lines.zh: 书我不换，别的东西可以。
lines.en: Books I do not trade. Other things, perhaps.
Set it on the corner of the desk.
I turn two pages and close it.
Leave it here; I will study it slowly.
I am old. I do not covet such things.
You bumped my bookshelf.
I caught a stack of books.
Please go around the table.
The shelf swayed; I caught it fast.
I step back and find my balance.

lines.zh: 你的手肘碰到墨水瓶了。
lines.en: Your elbow found the inkwell.
The tiles are old. Tread lightly.
Spells hide in my hat.
I right the inkwell you knocked askew.
Let us each keep to our own path.
I have lived alone many years.

lines.zh: 年轻的时候，我在学院里。
lines.en: When young I was at the academy.

lines.zh: 那时候有个人，总借我的书。
lines.en: There was someone then who always borrowed my books.

lines.zh: 她后来去了很远的地方。
lines.en: She went very far away afterward.
I have kept her handwriting.
There are letters I never answered.

lines.zh: 这间屋子是我自己建起来的。
lines.en: I built this house myself.
Books last longer than people.

lines.zh: 我偶尔想起她，就翻翻书。
lines.en: When I think of her, I open a book.

lines.zh: 这种事，说给谁听也没用。
lines.en: Telling anyone of it would change nothing.
A page has fallen to the floor.
I pick it up to see whose hand it is.
This may be of use.

lines.zh: 我把书摆回原来的位置。
lines.en: I put the book back where it belongs.
This nib is already broken.
I pick up a dried stalk.

lines.zh: 地上的纸我都收起来了。
lines.en: I gather up the papers on the floor.
This is too light to hold paper.

lines.zh: 我把它夹进书里做记号。
lines.en: I slip it into a book as a marker.

lines.zh: 这页纸有主，我夹回书里
lines.en: This page has an owner; I slip it back.
Someone has come into my house.
I heard the door pushed open.
Footsteps passed below.
I stop at the head of the stairs.
He stands there looking up at me.
I come down with a hand on the rail.
This one has come at a poor hour.

lines.zh: 我把袍子的袖子放下来。
lines.en: I let my sleeves fall.
He has something in his hand.
I look at him a while.
He dares not come up.
I come slowly to the foot of the stairs.
He keeps watching that wall of mine.
I hold my brim and murmur half a spell.
He raises what he is holding.
I am judging his distance to the door.
He backs toward the bookshelf.
There is no window there.
My fingers move inside my sleeve.
He has started speaking.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，光从指尖出。
lines.en: I sweep my hand and light leaves my fingers.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太窄，对我不利。
lines.en: This room is too tight for me.
I topple the shelf into his way.
He dodges the light and hits the table.

lines.zh: 我念了一句，他就站不稳。
lines.en: I speak a phrase and his footing fails.
That caught his shoulder.

lines.zh: 他又冲上来，我退到柱后。
lines.en: He rushes again and I step behind the post.
I catch his blade on my staff.

lines.zh: 我踢翻了蜡烛，屋里暗了。
lines.en: I knock the candle over and the room darkens.
I know the dark better than he does.

lines.zh: 我从楼上下来，一步一步。
lines.en: I come down the stairs, one step at a time.
This house has windows on all sides.
I open a book and close it again.

lines.zh: 桌上已经摆好了纸和墨。
lines.en: Paper and ink are already on the desk.
I have lived here a long while.
The yard is in good sun.
I hang my hat on the stand.
Someone knocks below.
I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没见过客人。
lines.en: I have not seen a guest in a long while.

lines.zh: 火星落在我袖子上，我拍打。
lines.en: Sparks fell on my sleeve and I beat them out.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I fell down the stairs, heavily.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的帽檐挡住眼睛。
lines.en: Water rose and my hat brim blinded me.

lines.zh: 爆响把我的书都掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast threw my books down.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进了我的书里。
lines.en: An arrow pinned my book.

lines.zh: 怪力压住我，我的咒语断了。
lines.en: Strange force pressed me and my words broke.
I forgot to eat and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的胡子都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my beard stood up.
The floor beneath me was gone.
